extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent attorneys/agents, inventors/applicants, and USPTO staff
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents for the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP), Edition 8 (E8, August 2001, Rev.1 Feb 2003); lists chapters, appendices, and availability information pointing to the substantive guidance used in patent examination and prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidated Laws
rubrics_metrics.description: The latest published version of the patent laws (Appendix L of the MPEP or Consolidated Patent Laws, whichever is more current).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the authoritative statutory law references incorporated into the MPEP; links to HTML/PDF/Accessible PDF versions are provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidated Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The latest published version of the patent rules (Appendix R of the MPEP or Consolidated Patent Rules, whichever is more current).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the authoritative procedural rules references incorporated into the MPEP; HTML/PDF/Accessible PDF links available.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to obtain a copy of the MPEP
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions and contact information for obtaining copies of the MPEP in various formats (HTML, PDF, accessible PDF, paper, DVD-ROM, microfilm).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes telephone numbers, USPS addresses, and ordering instructions for Superintendent of Documents and USPTO offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: MPEP Archives / Complete MPEP in three formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Announcement that the complete MPEP (including Feb 2003 revisions) is provided in three formats and zipped files to download the entire MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies availability of HTML, PDF, and Accessible PDF formats and provides zipped files for full-download.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title Page
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP title page (available in HTML/PDF/Accessible PDF).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard front matter for the manual; linked for viewing or download.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blue Pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Blue pages section of the MPEP (available in HTML/PDF/Accessible PDF).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains front-matter guidance specific to the edition (often update/notice material).

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory material for the MPEP (available in HTML/PDF/Accessible PDF).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains scope, use, and authority of the MPEP; links to formats provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0100 - 100 Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter covering secrecy orders, access restrictions, national security considerations, and procedures for foreign filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains statutory/regulatory and procedural guidance for handling national security and foreign filing issues during prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0200 - 200 Types, Cross-Noting, and Status of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter on types of patent applications (provisional, nonprovisional, continuations, etc.), cross-noting, and status reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides criteria and procedures for identifying application types and updating/cross-referencing application records.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0300 - 300 Ownership and Assignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter addressing ownership of patent rights, assignment recording, and related procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains requirements and forms for recording assignments and how ownership affects prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0400 - 400 Representative of Inventor or Owner
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter about representation before the USPTO, power of attorney, and duties of agents/attorneys.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes guidance on recognition of practitioners, change of representation, and practitioner responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0500 - 500 Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for receipt, processing, and handling of correspondence and papers filed with the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes acceptance rules, filing dates, handling delays, and related administrative policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0600 - 600 Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the form and content of patent applications, including specification, claims, drawings, and required elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets standards for sufficiency of disclosure, claim format, margins, and other formal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0700 - 700 Examination of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive guidance on examination procedures, examiner actions, office actions, and prosecution practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers search, examination criteria, rejections, allowances, interviews, and examiner-initiated actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0800 - 800 Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on restriction requirements, election of species, and double patenting issues under 35 U.S.C. 111.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when restriction is proper and how double patenting rejections are handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0900 - 900 Prior Art, Classification, Search
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for prior art searching, classification of technology, and evaluation of prior art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides search techniques, classification guidance, and criteria for relevance and novelty assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1000 - 1000 Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.description: Compilation of matters and decisions handled by various USPTO officials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes delegated authorities and decision-making processes within the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1100 - 1100 Statutory Invention Registration (SIR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on statutory invention registrations (SIR) and related procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains eligibility, filing, and effect of SIRs (historical procedures as applicable to the edition).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1200 - 1200 Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for appealing examiner decisions to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board and related appeal processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers notice of appeal, briefs, oral hearings, and standards applied on appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1300 - 1300 Allowance and Issue
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures governing allowance of applications, issue processes, and pre- and post-allowance formalities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes notices of allowance, issue fees, and preparation of the patent grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1400 - 1400 Correction of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for correcting patents (reissue, certificates of correction, disclaimers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains grounds and processes for reissue, correction of errors, and disclaimers.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1500 - 1500 Design Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and examination practice specific to design patent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers drawing standards, claim scope, novelty and ornamentality issues unique to designs.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1600 - 1600 Plant Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on plant patent practice and requirements for asexually reproduced plants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains disclosure, claim requirements, and illustrations specific to plant patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1700 - 1700 Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.description: Collection of miscellaneous topics relevant to patent prosecution not covered in other chapters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include varied procedural or substantive guidance; see chapter for particulars.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1800 - 1800 Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on PCT practice and procedures affecting U.S. national phase entries and related matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes PCT filing, national stage entry, and effect of international searches and written opinions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1900 - 1900 Protest
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for filing and processing protests against pending patent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains what constitutes a protest, timing, and the effect on examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2000 - 2000 Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards governing the duty of disclosure (duty to disclose material information to the Office) and related ethics duties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers what is material, timing of disclosures, and consequences of failure to disclose (inequitable conduct).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2100 - 2100 Patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive patentability criteria including novelty, nonobviousness, statutory subject matter, and enablement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary chapter for legal standards and examiner guidance on assessing patentability under relevant statutes and case law.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2200 - 2200 Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for citing prior art and conducting ex parte reexaminations of issued patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains submission of art, reexamination requests, and the standards for reexamination.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2300 - 2300 Interference Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on interference proceedings (derivation/priority contests) and related procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes grounds, filings, and determinations for priority disputes (historical context for pre-AIA issues).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2400 - 2400 Biotechnology
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized guidance on biotechnology-related patenting issues, including written description and enablement for biological inventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses best practices and legal standards specific to biotech subject matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2500 - 2500 Maintenance Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures for payment of patent maintenance fees and related policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes timing, grace periods, and effects of nonpayment.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2700 - 2700 Patent Terms and Extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for computing patent term and applying for patent term adjustments or extensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers statutory and regulatory bases for term adjustments, PTE, and calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix I - Partial List of Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix containing a partial list of trademarks referenced in the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supporting reference material; available in HTML/PDF/Accessible PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix II - List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix listing judicial and administrative decisions cited in the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for locating case law referenced by MPEP guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix L - Patent Laws
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix reproducing the patent statutes (patent laws) referenced throughout the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides statutory text for direct reference; superseded/updated material is noted via Consolidated Laws.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix R - Patent Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix reproducing the patent rules (regulatory provisions) referenced throughout the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides regulatory text for direct reference; see Consolidated Rules for the latest compilation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix T - Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix reproducing PCT text and related materials relevant to U.S. practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference material for PCT procedures and provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix AI - Administrative Instructions Under The PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix with administrative PCT instructions pertinent to U.S. practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides administrative guidance that complements the PCT text in Appendix T.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix P - Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix reproducing the Paris Convention provisions relevant to patent practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference for priority and international filing rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index - Subject Matter Index
rubrics_metrics.description: Subject-matter index for the MPEP to locate topics across chapters and appendices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available in HTML/PDF/Accessible PDF and intended to help users find specific guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zipped versions of the MPEP E8r1 in listed formats (HTML/PDF/Accessible PDF)
rubrics_metrics.description: Compressed bundles of the MPEP separated into chapter groups for download (Chapters 100-1000, 1100-2700, Apps and Remainder).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides download sizes and grouping; useful for offline use or bulk retrieval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of MPEP on Paper and in Other Formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on obtaining the MPEP on DVD-ROM, paper copies, and microfilm, including ordering addresses and telephone numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists contact points (Office of Electronic Information Products & Services, Superintendent of Documents) and instructions for ordering reproduced replacement pages or chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: DVD-ROM, Paper, and Microfilm Ordering Details
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific ordering instructions and contacts for DVD-ROM, paper subscriptions, individual replacement pages/chapters, and microfilm access to earlier editions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides postal addresses and telephone numbers for ordering and subscription management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Web Page Revision History and Comment Instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Revision history of the MPEP web pages (dates of updates) and where to send comments/suggestions regarding the web server.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Records dates of added revisions and files; provides contact information for General Information Services.
